summary: Hardened `/tmp` and `/dev/shm` with `noexec,nosuid,nodev`, persisted the configuration in `/etc/fstab`, and verified it after a full node restart.
actions_performed: Mounted `/tmp` as tmpfs with mode 1777 and the required restrictions.
Added persistent `/etc/fstab` entries and retained a backup at `/etc/fstab.pre-mount-hardening`.
Verified executable and device-node access is denied on both mounts.
Restarted node1 and confirmed a changed boot identity and complete recovery.

evidence.requirement: `/tmp` must ignore execution, setuid bits, and device nodes and survive reboot
evidence.summary: Shows the persistent fstab entry, all three live options, denied execution, denied device-node access, and successful post-restart verification.

evidence.requirement: `/dev/shm` must ignore execution, setuid bits, and device nodes and survive reboot
evidence.summary: Shows the persistent fstab entry, all three live options, denied execution, denied device-node access, and successful post-restart verification.
